phrase.zh: 记住转过的角度，才能辨认方向。
phrase.en: Track a turn to keep your bearings.

visual.zh: 齿轮和同心圆围着航行器排列，把陀螺测量与方向感转成机械图景。指针位置不代表某次飞行的姿态数据。
visual.en: Gears and circles surround a craft, turning gyroscopic measurement into a mechanical landscape. Pointer positions are not flight attitude data.

background.zh: 惯性测量单元中的陀螺仪感知方向变化，加速度计感知运动变化；航天器还会结合星敏感器或太阳传感器校正方向。仅靠惯性读数长期推算会积累误差。
background.en: An inertial measurement unit uses gyroscopes to sense turning and accelerometers to sense changes in motion; spacecraft also use star trackers or Sun sensors for orientation. Inertial estimates alone can accumulate error over time.
